aiStatement: If the Inclusive/Exclusive flag is 'N', the Tax Amount 3 field should be omitted.

facts: For Segment 143 Tax 3, Element 229 value N means the tax is not applicable to the product amount.
When the flag is N, both Tax Type 3 (Element 230) and Tax Amount 3 (Element 231) are omitted/skipped.
The AI BR accurately states the Element 231 omission but does not separately claim the coupled Element 230 omission.
sourceConclusion.scopeNote: The source-derived Test BR SEG143-R-006 spans the inclusive/exclusive flags for all three taxes; this review covers only the AI BRs' Tax 3 N branch.

aiChainReview.assessment: Four hash-verified candidate payloads declare all three tax-3 fields omitted, but the bounded observations do not establish Element 229 = N. The other eight cases have no exact observation for these fields. None proves the condition-to-omission chain.
limits: A declared omission of Elements 229, 230, and 231 does not establish that the condition flag was N.
